name: EXM_ENTERTAINMENT_POL_LINES
description: This table contains the details of a given entertainment policy. Each line in the table contains an entertainment policy rate and the applicable rate determinants.

columns.name: POLICY_LINE_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier of entertainment policy line for entertainment expense.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: ENTERTAINMENT_POLICY_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier of entertainment expense policy.

columns.name: TYPE_OF_ATTENDE_CODE
columns.description: Type of event attendee for this entertainment policy line. Values are from lookup EXM_ATTENDEE_TYPES.

columns.name: SINGLE_INSTANCE_LIMIT
columns.description: Single instance reimbursement limit for entertainment expenses.

columns.name: DAILY_LIMIT
columns.description: Daily reimbursement limit for entertainment expenses.

columns.name: YEARLY_LIMIT
columns.description: Annual reimbursement limit for entertainment expenses.

columns.name: CURRENCY_CODE
columns.description: Currency code for entertainment expense policies with multiple currencies.

columns.name: START_DATE
columns.description: Start date of entertainment expense policy line.

columns.name: END_DATE
columns.description: End date of entertainment expense policy line.

columns.name: TYPE_OF_RATE_CODE
columns.description: Type of rate line, such as base entertainment rate or catch all.

columns.name: ROLE_ID
columns.description: Role for which this entertainment expense policy rate is applicable.

columns.name: ROLE_NAME
columns.description: Role name for which this entertainment expense policy rate is applicable, such as Director or Engineer.

columns.name: STATUS
columns.description: Status of the entertainment expense policy line, whether draft, valid or invalid. Values are from lookup EXM_POLICY_STATUS.

columns.name: INVALID_CODE
columns.description: Reason that entertainment expense policy line has invalid status.
